card.name: Calling 911 for emergencies
card.fires_on: Words right around a "call 911" instruction, such as "call", "calling", and the space before 911, or the words after 911 that lead into "emergency". It appears in advice to seek emergency help.

modes.label: Just before 911
modes.description: The word "call" or "calling", or the space after it, right before the number 911.
modes.example: Convulsions and decreased consciousness are an emergency -- call<< >>911 or your local emergency number

modes.label: After 911
modes.description: Linking words after 911 that lead into emergency or local emergency number.
modes.example: Call 911<< for>> all medical emergencies. Links to other sites

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with emergency and call-for-help words, such as emergency, dispatch and call.
card.plain: It fires when the text tells the reader to call 911 or get emergency help.
